system.name: UCCL-Tran
system.one_liner: an extensible, portable software transport layer for GPU networking that sits between collective libraries and NIC primitives

components.name: ML Applications
components.role: applications issuing collective (e.g. allreduce) and point-to-point (e.g. SendRecv) calls via the collective library

components.name: Collective Library
components.role: e.g. NCCL; compiled as libnccl.so, calls into the UCCL-Tran layer as a drop-in network plugin

components.name: uTran Layer
components.role: UCCL-Tran's layer implementing CC, LB and loss recovery over RC/UC/UD/AF_XDP primitives

components.name: RC
components.role: reliable-connection RDMA transport primitive used by the uTran Layer

components.name: UC
components.role: unreliable-connection RDMA transport primitive used by the uTran Layer

components.name: UD
components.role: unreliable-datagram RDMA transport primitive used by the uTran Layer

components.name: AF_XDP
components.role: user-space fast packet I/O primitive used for non-RDMA NICs

components.name: CPU 1
components.role: a server CPU connected to a PCIe switch

components.name: CPU 2
components.role: a second server CPU connected to another PCIe switch

components.name: PCIe switch
components.role: connects CPUs, GPUs and NICs within the server for high-bandwidth data transfer

components.name: GPU 1
components.role: a GPU behind PCIe switch 1

components.name: GPU 8
components.role: a GPU behind PCIe switch 8

components.name: NIC 1
components.role: the RDMA/AF_XDP NIC paired with GPU 1 for network traffic

components.name: NIC 8
components.role: the RDMA/AF_XDP NIC paired with GPU 8

components.name: Multipath Datacenter Network
components.role: the datacenter fabric connecting servers' NICs to each other

components.name: App
components.role: the application issuing collective calls

components.name: uTran Plugin
components.role: the network-plugin entry point the collective library calls into (connect/accept/send/recv/etc.)

components.name: uTran engines (TX, RX, Pacer)
components.role: the group of engine threads that actually execute transport functionality

components.name: Conn A
components.role: one connection's state, tracking paths plus CC & LB state

components.name: Conn B
components.role: another connection's state

components.name: QP
components.role: queue pairs owned by each connection for posting network operations

flows.what: applications call collective APIs (e.g. allreduce) and point-to-point APIs (e.g. SendRecv)
the collective library's network-plugin system routes into the UCCL-Tran layer without code changes
transport primitives (RC/UC/UD/AF_XDP) issue network operations to the RDMA/AF_XDP NIC
network traffic leaves the server over the multipath datacenter network
the app/collective library calls connect/accept/regmr/deregmr/send/recv/flush/poll on the plugin
plugin and engine threads interact via shared memory (SHM) to create connections and register memory

content.key_idea: UCCL-Tran is a drop-in, extensible software transport layer inserted between an unmodified collective library and NIC hardware primitives, implemented as a plugin plus a pool of TX/RX/Pacer engine threads that manage per-connection paths and congestion/loss control entirely in user-space software.
content.reading_order: Panel (a) shows the software stack over the server's hardware out to the datacenter network; panel (b) zooms into the threading model, from App to the engine threads.

summary: UCCL-Tran is an extensible software transport layer for GPU networking, designed as a drop-in replacement beneath existing collective libraries. Figure 2's two panels show the design at two levels. Panel (a) gives the high-level architecture: ML Applications call a Collective Library such as NCCL, which loads the uTran Layer as its network plugin; the uTran Layer implements congestion control, load balancing and loss recovery over RC/UC/UD RDMA primitives or AF_XDP, sitting above a concrete server topology of two CPUs and eight PCIe-switched GPUs and NICs connected out through a Multipath Datacenter Network, with control-header, data-payload and network-traffic arrows color-coded per the legend. Panel (b) shows the threading model: an App and Collective Library call into the uTran Plugin, which coordinates over shared memory with a pool of uTran engine threads (TX, RX, Pacer) tracking per-connection paths, CC/LB state and queue pairs.
summary_zh: 图2展示UCCL-Tran:(a)架构—应用经NCCL调用uTran层(拥塞控制/负载均衡/丢包恢复),经RC/UC/UD/AF_XDP驱动GPU与网卡;(b)线程模型—App经插件与TX/RX/Pacer引擎协作,管理连接与队列状态。
